title: P(X = x) = c/x
caption: Heights in elevenths are 6, 3, 2 (that is 6/x), total 11, so c = 6/11 and P(X = 1) = 6/11 ≈ 0.545.
alt: Bar chart for x = 1, 2, 3 with heights 6, 3, 2 elevenths.
description: The probabilities are proportional to 1, 1/2, 1/3, that is 6 : 3 : 2.
They total 11 parts, so each part is 1/11 and P(X = 1) = 6/11.
